title: AHB Burst Type vs Response Coverage
description: Select the declared interface revision before interpreting response legality. ERROR bins retain first/middle/final accepted-beat counts; RETRY and SPLIT are distinct original-AHB responses and are illegal on AHB-Lite/AHB5.

configurations.label: AHB-Lite / AHB5
configurations.description: One-bit HRESP permits OKAY and ERROR only; RETRY and SPLIT rows are configuration-derived illegal bins.

configurations.label: Original AMBA 2 AHB
configurations.description: RETRY and SPLIT are legal response categories. RETRY does not use HSPLITx; SPLIT eligibility is restored by HSPLITx. Zero hits are coverage holes, not illegal bins.
